blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解 PDA TR1 的歷史沿革與修訂目的
blocks.en: Understand the history of PDA TR1 and the purpose of the revision

blocks.zh: 掌握本報告的適用範圍與侷限性
blocks.en: Understand the scope and limitations of this report

blocks.zh: 熟悉 2.0 節中所有關鍵術語的定義
blocks.en: Become familiar with the definitions of all key terms in Section 2.0

blocks.zh: 區分致死性相關指標（D值、z值、F0值）的概念差異
blocks.en: Distinguish the lethality-related metrics (D-value, z-value, F0 value)

blocks.zh: 了解過度殺滅法（Overkill）與生物負載法（Bioburden-based）的設計邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the design logic of the overkill approach and the bioburden-based approach

blocks.zh: 掌握 SAL（無菌保證水準）的量化意義
blocks.en: Grasp the quantitative meaning of SAL (sterility assurance level)

blocks.zh: TR1 的歷史地位
blocks.en: The Standing of TR1

blocks.zh: PDA TR1 的前身是 1978 年發布的《蒸汽滅菌週期確效》技術專論，距今已超過 45 年。2007 年修訂版將標題更名為「濕熱滅菌製程確效」，涵蓋週期設計、開發、確效與持續管控，範圍更廣、科學依據更紮實。
blocks.en: The predecessor of PDA TR1 was the 1978 technical monograph "Validation of Steam Sterilization Cycles," published more than 45 years ago. The 2007 revision retitled it "Validation of Moist Heat Sterilization Processes" and covers cycle design, development, qualification and ongoing control, with a broader scope and a firmer scientific basis.

blocks.zh: 這份文件由歐美業界與法規專家共同撰寫，代表當時全球滅菌科學的共識基準，至今仍是 FDA 及 EMA 查廠時常被引用的工業指引。
blocks.en: The document was written jointly by industry and regulatory experts from Europe and the US. It represents the consensus on sterilization science at the time and remains an industry guide frequently cited during FDA and EMA inspections.

blocks.zh: 重要定位提醒
blocks.en: Important Positioning Reminder

blocks.zh: TR1 是「指引」（guide），不是法規標準。它不強制規定特定方法，但提供科學建議。實際操作時，仍需參考各地法規（FDA、EMA、PIC/S 等）。
blocks.en: TR1 is a "guide," not a regulatory standard. It does not mandate specific methods but offers scientific recommendations. In practice, you must still refer to the regulations in each region (FDA, EMA, PIC/S, etc.).

blocks.zh: 類比說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把 TR1 想像成一本「最佳實務教科書」，不是法律條文。它告訴你「為什麼這樣做更科學」，而不是「你必須這樣做」。但查廠時若你的做法偏離 TR1，審查員可能會問你為何偏離，你需要有科學依據。
blocks.en: Think of TR1 as a "best-practice textbook," not a legal text. It tells you "why doing it this way is more scientific," not "you must do it this way." But if your practice deviates from TR1 during an inspection, the inspector may ask why, and you will need a scientific justification.

blocks.zh: Scope | 適用範圍
blocks.en: Scope

blocks.zh: TR1 的報告架構
blocks.en: Structure of the TR1 Report

blocks.zh: TR1 採用「由科學基礎到實務應用」的邏輯順序：
blocks.en: TR1 follows a logical order "from scientific foundations to practical application":

blocks.zh: Section 2：術語定義（本節學習基礎）
blocks.en: Section 2: Definitions of terms (the foundation for this section)

blocks.zh: Section 3：滅菌科學（微生物學 + 熱力學）
blocks.en: Section 3: Sterilization science (microbiology + thermodynamics)

blocks.zh: Section 4：製程開發（週期設計 + 決策樹）
blocks.en: Section 4: Process development (cycle design + decision tree)

blocks.zh: Section 5：PPQ 製程效能確效（物理 + 生物確效）
blocks.en: Section 5: PPQ, process performance qualification (physical + biological qualification)

blocks.zh: Section 6：持續管控（變更管控 + 系統適用性 + 再確效）
blocks.en: Section 6: Ongoing control (change control + system suitability + requalification)

blocks.zh: 範圍邊界（重要！）
blocks.en: Scope Boundaries (Important!)

blocks.zh: TR1 不適用於實驗室、醫院等非 CGMP 環境。設備確效（IQ/OQ）、設施、公用系統等也不在本報告範疇內。這些限制在查廠時很重要——別拿 TR1 當作設備確效的依據。
blocks.en: TR1 does not apply to non-CGMP settings such as laboratories and hospitals. Equipment qualification (IQ/OQ), facilities and utility systems are also outside the scope of this report. These limits matter during inspections: do not cite TR1 as the basis for equipment qualification.

blocks.zh: PPQ 的核心地位
blocks.en: The Central Role of PPQ

blocks.zh: TR1 明確指出 PPQ（Section 5）是「滅菌製程確效的核心（heart）」。這句話點明了一個重要觀念：IQ/OQ 只是前提，真正能向法規機關證明製程有效的，是 PPQ 的物理與生物數據。
blocks.en: TR1 states explicitly that PPQ (Section 5) is "the heart" of sterilization process validation. This makes an important point: IQ/OQ are only prerequisites, and what can truly demonstrate to regulators that the process is effective is the physical and biological data from PPQ.

blocks.zh: 兩種週期設計方法預告
blocks.en: Preview of the Two Cycle Design Approaches

blocks.zh: Section 4 會介紹兩種主流設計方法：
blocks.en: Section 4 introduces two mainstream design approaches:

blocks.zh: 過度殺滅法（Overkill）：不需了解生物負載，以最差情況假設設計，目標 F0 > 12 分鐘
blocks.en: Overkill approach: no knowledge of the bioburden is required; the cycle is designed on worst-case assumptions, targeting F0 > 12 minutes

blocks.zh: 生物負載法（Bioburden-based / Product-Specific）：根據實際生物負載與產品熱敏感性設計，PNSU ≤ 10⁻⁶
blocks.en: Bioburden-based (product-specific) approach: the cycle is designed from the actual bioburden and the heat sensitivity of the product, with PNSU ≤ 10⁻⁶

blocks.zh: Glossary of Terms | 術語詞彙
blocks.en: Glossary of Terms

blocks.zh: 術語標準化的意義
blocks.en: Why Standardized Terminology Matters

blocks.zh: TR1 強調術語必須在公司內部明確定義並達成共識。查廠時，審查員可能直接問「你們 F0 是如何定義的？」或「你們的 D值 是在哪個溫度下量測的？」確保 SOP 與確效文件中的術語與 TR1 一致，可大幅降低溝通風險。
blocks.en: TR1 stresses that terms must be clearly defined and agreed upon within the company. During an inspection, the inspector may ask directly, "How do you define F0?" or "At what temperature was your D-value measured?" Making sure the terms in your SOPs and validation documents are consistent with TR1 greatly reduces the risk of miscommunication.

blocks.zh: Glossary — Part 1: Lethality & Measurement Concepts | 致死性與量測概念
blocks.en: Glossary - Part 1: Lethality & Measurement Concepts

blocks.zh: 術語學習 — 致死性概念群 (繁體中文)
blocks.en: Terminology Study - Lethality Concepts (Commentary)

blocks.zh: D值、z值、F0值的關係
blocks.en: Relationship Between D-value, z-value and F0 Value

blocks.zh:
D值：殺死 90% 微生物所需的分鐘數（在特定溫度下）
z值：使 D值 改變 10 倍所需的溫度變化（°C）
F0值：以 121°C、z=10°C 為基準的等效滅菌時間（分鐘）

公式：L（致死率）= 10^[(T - 121) / z]
F0 = ∫L dt（對時間積分）
blocks.en:
D-value: the number of minutes required to kill 90% of the microorganisms (at a specific temperature)
z-value: the temperature change (°C) required to change the D-value by a factor of 10
F0 value: the equivalent sterilization time (minutes) referenced to 121°C and z = 10°C

Formula: L (lethal rate) = 10^[(T - 121) / z]
F0 = ∫L dt (integrated over time)

blocks.zh: 例如：若 D<sub>121°C</sub> = 1.5 分鐘，代表每隔 1.5 分鐘，微生物數量減少 90%（一個 log）。
blocks.en: Example: if D<sub>121°C</sub> = 1.5 minutes, the microbial population is reduced by 90% (one log) every 1.5 minutes.

blocks.zh: SAL vs PNSU — 容易混淆的雙胞胎
blocks.en: SAL vs PNSU - Easily Confused Twins

blocks.zh: SAL（無菌保證水準）和 PNSU（非無菌單位機率）是同一概念的不同稱呼。藥廠標準：PNSU ≤ 10<sup>–6</sup>，即每百萬個產品中非無菌品不超過 1 個。
blocks.en: SAL (sterility assurance level) and PNSU (probability of a nonsterile unit) are different names for the same concept. The pharmaceutical standard is PNSU ≤ 10<sup>–6</sup>, i.e., no more than 1 nonsterile unit per million products.

blocks.zh: 注意反直覺邏輯：SAL 數字越小（10–6 < 10–3），無菌保證越高。
blocks.en: Note the counterintuitive logic: the smaller the SAL number (10–6 < 10–3), the higher the sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: F<sub>physical</sub> vs F<sub>biological</sub>：兩種驗證角度
blocks.en: F<sub>physical</sub> vs F<sub>biological</sub>: Two Validation Perspectives

blocks.zh: Fphysical：從溫度感測器數據計算 → 物理確效（Physical Qualification）
blocks.en: Fphysical: calculated from temperature sensor data → physical qualification

blocks.zh: Fbiological：從 BI 實際存活數計算 → 生物確效（Biological Qualification）
blocks.en: Fbiological: calculated from the actual BI survivors → biological qualification

blocks.zh: 兩者需互相驗證：物理計算的 F0 應能預測 BI 的殺滅效果。
blocks.en: The two must confirm each other: the physically calculated F0 should predict the kill achieved on the BI.

blocks.zh: 類比：F0值 就像「等效工作時間」
blocks.en: Analogy: the F0 Value Is Like "Equivalent Working Time"

blocks.zh: 想像你用 121°C 工作 8 分鐘，等同於你用 116°C 工作 25.9 分鐘（F0 同為 8 分鐘）。溫度越高，每分鐘的殺滅效果（致死率 L）越大。z值則描述溫度對效率的影響程度。
blocks.en: Imagine working 8 minutes at 121°C is equivalent to working 25.9 minutes at 116°C (F0 is 8 minutes in both cases). The higher the temperature, the greater the kill effect per minute (lethal rate L). The z-value describes how strongly temperature affects efficiency.

blocks.zh: Glossary — Part 2: Biological Indicator Concepts | 生物指示劑相關概念
blocks.en: Glossary - Part 2: Biological Indicator Concepts

blocks.zh: 術語學習 — 生物指示劑概念群 (繁體中文)
blocks.en: Terminology Study - Biological Indicator Concepts (Commentary)

blocks.zh: 生物指示劑（BI）的功能
blocks.en: The Function of Biological Indicators (BI)

blocks.zh: BI 是滅菌確效中的「終極考驗」——用已知數量、已知耐熱性的純培養微生物，實際放入滅菌器中測試。最常用的是 Geobacillus stearothermophilus 孢子，因其對濕熱具有高度耐受性。
blocks.en: The BI is the "ultimate test" in sterilization validation: a pure culture of microorganisms of known number and known heat resistance is placed in the sterilizer and actually challenged. The most commonly used is Geobacillus stearothermophilus spores, because of their high resistance to moist heat.

blocks.zh: BI 的 D<sub>121°C</sub> 通常為 1.5～2.5 分鐘，初始孢子數約 10<sup>6</sup>，用於模擬最差情境。
blocks.en: The D<sub>121°C</sub> of a BI is typically 1.5–2.5 minutes, with an initial spore count of about 10<sup>6</sup>, used to simulate the worst case.

blocks.zh: 半週期確效法（Half-Cycle Qualification）
blocks.en: Half-Cycle Qualification

blocks.zh: 這是過度殺滅法（Overkill）中常見的確效策略：以正式週期一半的曝露時間進行測試，若 BI 全數滅活，則推論完整週期的殺滅能力至少是 2 倍，保守估計足以達到 10<sup>–6</sup> SAL。
blocks.en: This is a common qualification strategy in the overkill approach: testing is performed with half the exposure time of the full cycle. If all BIs are inactivated, the full cycle is inferred to have at least twice the kill capability, conservatively sufficient to achieve an SAL of 10<sup>–6</sup>.

blocks.zh: Fraction-Negative 方法類比
blocks.en: Fraction-Negative Method Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你在測試一批 BI：在某個曝露時間，有些 BI 長菌（陽性）、有些沒有（陰性）。這個「混合區間」就是 quantal range，用來精確推算 D 值。比直接用「全滅/全活」更有統計力。
blocks.en: Imagine testing a batch of BIs: at a given exposure time, some BIs show growth (positive) and some do not (negative). This "mixed zone" is the quantal range, used to calculate the D-value precisely. It is statistically more powerful than simply using "all killed / all survived."

blocks.zh: Glossary — Part 3: Process & Cycle Concepts | 製程與週期概念
blocks.en: Glossary - Part 3: Process & Cycle Concepts

blocks.zh: 術語學習 — 製程與週期概念群 (繁體中文)
blocks.en: Terminology Study - Process and Cycle Concepts (Commentary)

blocks.zh: MAC vs Routine Cycle — 操作上的緩衝
blocks.en: MAC vs Routine Cycle - an Operational Buffer

blocks.zh: MAC（最低可接受週期）是放行的最低門檻；Routine Cycle（日常操作週期）通常設計為比 MAC 還多給一些致死量（lethality margin）。這樣即使設備有輕微波動，仍能超過 MAC 放行。查廠時需能清楚解釋兩者的差異。
blocks.en: MAC (minimum acceptable cycle) is the minimum threshold for release; the Routine Cycle (routine operating cycle) is usually designed to deliver some additional lethality (lethality margin) beyond the MAC. This way, even with minor equipment fluctuations, the cycle still exceeds the MAC for release. You must be able to explain the difference between the two clearly during an inspection.

blocks.zh: Cold Spot（冷點）的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of the Cold Spot

blocks.zh: 冷點是整個滅菌負載中接受到最少致死量的位置，是 Physical Qualification 的重點量測對象。確效必須在冷點位置安裝熱電偶，確保即使在最難達到高溫的地方，F0 仍然達標。
blocks.en: The cold spot is the location within the sterilization load that receives the least lethality and is the main target of measurement in physical qualification. Qualification must place thermocouples at the cold spot to ensure that F0 is still achieved even in the place where it is hardest to reach high temperature.

blocks.zh: Parametric Release（參數放行）
blocks.en: Parametric Release

blocks.zh: 傳統放行需做最終產品無菌測試（成本高、時間長）。Parametric Release 允許以已驗證的製程物理參數數據取代最終無菌測試，條件是：製程已充分驗證、控制完善、記錄齊全。歐盟法規（Annex 1）已認可此方法。
blocks.en: Traditional release requires sterility testing of the final product (costly and time-consuming). Parametric release allows validated physical process parameter data to replace final product sterility testing, provided the process is fully validated, well controlled and fully documented. EU regulations (Annex 1) recognize this approach.

blocks.zh: Bracketing 策略類比
blocks.en: Analogy for the Bracketing Strategy

blocks.zh: 想像你有 10 種不同容量的注射瓶（5 mL 到 500 mL）。Bracketing 的邏輯是：只確效最小（5 mL，最快達溫）和最大（500 mL，最慢達溫）兩個極端，中間尺寸視為「已被涵蓋」。這大幅減少確效工作量，但需要科學論證支持。
blocks.en: Imagine you have 10 injection vials of different volumes (5 mL to 500 mL). The logic of bracketing is to qualify only the two extremes, the smallest (5 mL, fastest to reach temperature) and the largest (500 mL, slowest to reach temperature), and treat the sizes in between as "covered." This greatly reduces the qualification workload, but it requires a supporting scientific rationale.

blocks.zh: Glossary — Part 4: Steam Types & Equipment Concepts | 蒸汽類型與設備概念
blocks.en: Glossary - Part 4: Steam Types & Equipment Concepts

blocks.zh: 術語學習 — 蒸汽類型與設備群 (繁體中文)
blocks.en: Terminology Study - Steam Types and Equipment (Commentary)

blocks.zh: 超熱蒸汽（Superheated Steam）的危險
blocks.en: The Danger of Superheated Steam

blocks.zh: 超熱蒸汽雖然溫度高，但殺菌效果比飽和蒸汽差！原因是超熱蒸汽缺乏濕氣（latent heat），無法有效將熱量傳遞給微生物的蛋白質。飽和蒸汽的冷凝液化才是濕熱殺菌的主要機制。
blocks.en: Although superheated steam is hot, its sterilizing effect is poorer than that of saturated steam. The reason is that superheated steam lacks moisture (latent heat) and cannot effectively transfer heat to the proteins of the microorganisms. Condensation of saturated steam is the main mechanism of moist heat sterilization.

blocks.zh: 重力排氣法 vs 預真空法
blocks.en: Gravity Displacement vs Prevacuum

blocks.zh: 重力排氣法（Gravity Displacement）：適合簡單的液態或無孔洞負載；空氣從底部排出，但排氣不完全。
blocks.en: Gravity displacement: suited to simple liquid loads or nonporous loads; air is expelled from the bottom, but air removal is incomplete.

blocks.zh: 預真空法（Prevacuum）：適合多孔、管狀、或複雜形狀的硬質貨物；機械泵強制抽真空，排氣效果更佳。填充機組件（灌裝機零件）必用此法。
blocks.en: Prevacuum: suited to porous, tubular or complex-shaped hard goods; a mechanical pump forces a vacuum, giving better air removal. It must be used for filling machine components (filling line parts).

blocks.zh: 不可凝氣體（Noncondensable Gases）的問題
blocks.en: The Problem of Noncondensable Gases

blocks.zh: 空氣（不可凝氣體）如果殘留在滅菌腔中，會在某些位置形成「空氣包」，導致該區域溫度偏低、達不到滅菌效果。這就是為什麼空氣去除測試（Air Removal Test / Bowie-Dick Test）是 P/HG 負載確效的關鍵步驟。
blocks.en: If air (a noncondensable gas) remains in the sterilization chamber, it can form "air pockets" in certain locations, leaving those areas at a lower temperature where sterilization is not achieved. This is why the air removal test (Air Removal Test / Bowie-Dick Test) is a key step in the qualification of porous/hard goods (P/HG) loads.

blocks.zh: Pure Steam（純蒸汽）的冷凝水需符合注射用水（WFI）標準，無熱原、微生物、重金屬超標等問題。直接接觸產品或產品接觸面的滅菌必須使用 Pure Steam，不可用工業蒸汽（Industrial Steam）。這是 GMP 基本要求。
blocks.en: The condensate of Pure Steam must meet WFI (water for injection) standards, with no pyrogens, microorganisms or excess heavy metals. Pure Steam must be used for sterilization that directly contacts the product or product-contact surfaces; industrial steam must not be used. This is a basic GMP requirement.

blocks.zh: 練習題 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: Q1：某 BI 的 D121°C = 2.0 分鐘，初始菌數 N0 = 106。若以 Overkill 法設計，理論上完整週期（F0 > 12 分鐘）能達到幾個 log 的降低？SAL 是否滿足 10–6 的要求？請說明計算邏輯。
blocks.en: Q1: A BI has a D121°C = 2.0 minutes and an initial count N0 = 106. If the cycle is designed using the overkill approach, how many logs of reduction can the full cycle (F0 > 12 minutes) theoretically achieve? Does the SAL meet the 10–6 requirement? Explain the calculation logic.

blocks.zh: Q2：一家工廠的注射劑滅菌器使用重力排氣法（Gravity Displacement），但某批次在確效時，腔室角落的熱電偶讀數比設定溫度低 2°C，持續整個曝露期間。請問：(a) 這代表什麼問題？(b) 應如何評估對 F0 的影響？(c) 下一步應採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: Q2: A plant's injectable sterilizer uses gravity displacement. During qualification of one batch, the thermocouple in a corner of the chamber read 2°C below the set temperature throughout the entire exposure period. (a) What problem does this indicate? (b) How should the impact on F0 be evaluated? (c) What action should be taken next?
